messages.content: Propose ONE concrete promising learning algorithm, not an audit or a security protocol, for a world-model paper. We have native ScienceWorld and DiscoveryWorld and one RTX4090. Empirical finding A: truthful experience can corrupt shared world-model forecasts, yet competent actors repeatedly recover and succeed; fixes do not always repair the shared model. Finding B: in Reactor Lab, simple symbolic laws fit reference crystals, but environmental radiation contaminates the measured feature. Source-informed isolation+32 repeated minimum measurements solves 4/4 fresh cases. Searching fixed measurement-location/count/reducer templates plus remeasurement validation also solves4/4, but costs7.37x actions. Neither is a novel contribution. Existing close priors: CausalCuriosity/GalilAI optimize experimental action sequences using causal-factor/model simplicity; MDA jointly proposes scientific model and experiments/observation summaries; task-oriented model learning matches policy gradients; VERDI retrieves and tests repairs. General expressibility as meta-learning/active learning is NOT a novelty disqualifier. We need a concrete changed learning operation relative to specific prior algorithms, with a broad simple idea and an affordable native experiment. Suggest a mechanism motivated by these findings, specify its state, exact update, decisive baseline, and first falsification pilot. Avoid more finite-template search, manually scripted calibration, or merely weighting data, predicting correction probability, or adding another prompt. Think mechanistically; up to700 words. Explicitly identify what remains speculative. We can pivot beyond security.
